title: Bigambul language
extract: Bigambul is an extinct and unclassified Australian Aboriginal language from the Pama–Nyungan language family. The Bigambul language region includes the landscape within the local government boundaries of the Goondiwindi Regional Council, including the towns of Goondiwindi, Yelarbon and Texas extending north towards Moonie and Millmerran. The AUSTLANG database maintained by the Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies states that the Bigambul language was spoken by the Bigambul people, with Gambuwal and Kwiambal known dialects. However, it is likely that the Gamilaraay language was used by those peoples living in southern Bigambul territory.
